hebrewText: וַֽ/יִּגְּשׁ֗וּ רָאשֵׁי֙ אֲב֣וֹת הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם אֶל אֶלְעָזָר֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן נ֑וּן וְ/אֶל רָאשֵׁ֛י אֲב֥וֹת הַ/מַּטּ֖וֹת לִ/בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

tokens.bdb: to be or come (causatively, bring) near (for any purpose); euphemistically, to lie with a woman; as an enemy, to attack; religious to worship; causatively, to present; figuratively, to adduce an argument; by reversal, to stand back
tokens.kjv: (make to) approach (nigh), bring (forth, hither, near), (cause to) come (hither, near, nigh), give place, go hard (up), (be, draw, go) near (nigh), offer, overtake, present, put, stand.

tokens.bdb: the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)
tokens.kjv: band, beginning, captain, chapiter, chief(-est place, man, things), company, end, [idiom] every (man), excellent, first, forefront, (be-)head, height, (on) high(-est part, (priest)), [idiom] lead, [idiom] poor, principal, ruler, sum, top.

tokens.bdb: father, in a literal and immediate, or figurative and remote application
tokens.kjv: chief, (fore-) father(-less), [idiom] patrimony, principal. Compare names in 'Abi-'.
